claims.text: The model works best for predicting implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows improved performance on explicit discourse relations, particularly on the contingency relation, but does not specify a worst-performing relation.
The model is less effective for binary classification of discourse relations, as indicated by the CRF layer's unsuitability for this task.
